script_text: Taurus rising, stop—the scales are tipping. The Sun is entering Libra in your 6th House, trining Pluto in your 11th House and opposing Saturn in your 12th House. This Sun-Pluto trine can turn connections into breakthroughs, while Saturn's opposition tests your capacity to share burdens and finish what you start. Venus, your ruling planet, reinforces Taurus's fixed-earth steadiness. In your 7th House of Partnerships, a commitment or money issue may surface through a friend or group; taken Taurus should address it, while singles may attract loyal people through social circles. At work, Saturn, ruler of your 10th House in Aquarius, sits in the 12th, favoring research and confidential proposals; present a budget or timeline, because a partnership may bring financial gain. Avoid impulsive commitments or silence; your unexpected gift is a quiet collaborator who becomes a valuable ally. Follow for tomorrow's reading and see what comes next.
